update_procedure: Never edit a vendored file in place. A changed expectation needs a new corpus version upstream and a review explanation there.

To move to a new version: check out the harness at the revision to vendor, copy manifest.json and corpus/*.json from source_path into a sibling directory named after the new contract version, and delete this one.
Record the revision, versions, and the SHA-256 of the upstream SHA256SUMS file (shasum -a 256 SHA256SUMS) in the new SOURCE.json.
Regenerate files with: (cd <new directory> && shasum -a 256 manifest.json corpus/*.json).
Point CORPUS_DIR in tests/test_rules_v2_v1_contract.rs at the new directory and reconcile UNSUPPORTED_CASE_IDS with the new manifest.
